translations.web: Therefore you shall be perfect, just as your Father in heaven is perfect.
translations.bsb: Be perfect, therefore, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
translations.kjv: Be ye therefore perfect, even as your Father which is in heaven is perfect.
translations.asv: Ye therefore shall be perfect, as your heavenly Father is perfect.
